scope.captureBoundary: Core/environment images sample the padded data-visual-frame with primary/disabled comparison and output/error text. Zoom PNGs are the full current visible viewport1264x805 physical pixels, not full-page; inventory is1280x720 default viewport.

resolvedPriorFindings.scope: MD3 light/dark ×small/medium/large disabled-selected, six images actually viewed.
resolvedPriorFindings.observation: The disabled selected checkbox retains its neutral tick and output now says 当前选择: on.
resolvedPriorFindings.sourceBasis: Demo derives effectiveChecked once for checked prop and output. assertCheckboxFeedback compares output and aria-checked against native checked/indeterminate properties rather than mirrored data attributes.

conclusions: All112 original PNGs were individually reopened at original detail for this new candidate, including repeated hashes and images identical to the old candidate.
All six disabled-selected MD3 images now show the visible tick and 当前选择:on consistently; the prior contradictory output is not reproduced.

All18 mixed-state images (indeterminate, indeterminate-error, disabled-indeterminate) show a dash and explicit mixed/半选 with boolean:off. The photos here cover checked=false+indeterminate=true; native no-PNG boundary evidence for checked=true+indeterminate=true is not expanded into manual image approval.
Three sizes and both modes retain distinct tick/mixed dash, neutral disabled state and error outline/fill. Error explanations are visible and intact.
Actual hover/mouse-down press frames show circle state layers; keyboard focus frames retain a complete independent exterior ring without crop.
320px and English long labels wrap fully; RTL positioning, brand, forced-colors and reduced-motion are scoped to their actual sampled environment.
Touch uses actual tap and native coarse-pointer/48x48 control assertions; PNGs preserve tick, state layer and complete label.

Real200% proofs use chrome.tabs.setZoom=2, html/body zoom1, CSS viewport632x402 and physical PNG1264x805. Tick/focus ring/long label/disabled comparison/output remain within the current visible viewport; not full-page acceptance.
No new visual or Demo-feedback issue was found within the assigned Windows Chromium MD3 images.

evidence.overallNativeEnvironment: 60/60 across three designs; this manual review only MD3 20/20 images including two real200% views

The previous candidate and its pending issue records remain unchanged. This new-candidate fix confirmation does not rewrite old findings.
The two inventory PNGs cover default viewport only; no-PNG boundary assertions do not count as manually viewed images.
Videos were not reviewed. Single PNGs do not prove transition timing or continuous animation advancement.
No browser capture/build/source/test/product edit was performed in this review. Only new review files were written.
Standalone collection density beyond standard is documented not applicable; loading is owned by the form.
No canonical baseline, verified coverage or lifecycle was established.
